main_body: Flat grass ground patch (4x3 tiles) with repeating tufts and dark clumps; terrain tile, not a standing object
top_band: none - ground texture, no standing top/front structure
evidence: The candidate is a seamless grass ground texture, which is terrain and not a standing object. The 3/4 top-and-front contract does not apply. It has no front-elevation, side-elevation or top-down object structure and no side faces. Nothing about it breaks the terrain kind.

style.evidence: The grass uses about 4 greens: a mid base, light tuft highlights, dark clump patches and a few darker dots. The tufts repeat on a very regular grid, so the tiling is obvious, and the dark clumps look stamped rather than organic. The mid-green base is largely uniform between tufts, with sparse variation. The reference grass has more varied blades and soil grain and lighter, more irregular speckle. Per-tile colour count is probably 4-6 against about 10 in the reference, so density is somewhat lower. There are no outlines, which suits ground. Compared with the reference it reads thinner and more mechanical.
